title: Business Sales Consultant
description:
Business Sales Consultant

Trade Mastermind Peterborough HQ

40,000 Basic Salary + 100,000 to 200,000+ OTE (Uncapped)

Uncapped Commission Premium Leads Career Progression High-Performance Culture

About Trade Mastermind

Trade Mastermind is one of the UK's leading business growth organisations, helping ambitious business owners build more profitable, scalable, and valuable companies.

Through our coaching, training, events, and business development programmes, we support entrepreneurs in improving sales, marketing, recruitment, leadership, operations, and financial performance.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a talented Business Sales Consultant to join our team and help business owners take their companies to the next level.

The Opportunity

This is far more than a traditional sales role. We are looking for someone who can engage in meaningful conversations with business owners, understand their commercial challenges, and identify opportunities for growth. You will act as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process, helping entrepreneurs make informed decisions about investing in their future.

You will work with warm inbound enquiries and prospective clients who are actively seeking support to grow their businesses. Your role will be to build strong relationships, uncover opportunities, present solutions, and ultimately secure investment into our premium business growth programmes.

This position would suit an ambitious salesperson who combines strong closing ability with commercial awareness and enjoys discussing business strategy, growth, leadership, profitability, and performance.

Key Responsibilities

Speak with business owners, entrepreneurs, and company directors daily.

Conduct discovery and qualification conversations to understand business goals and challenges.

Build rapport and credibility with prospective clients.

Present Trade Mastermind's programmes and growth solutions.

Guide prospects through the sales journey from initial enquiry through to enrolment.

Attend workshops and business events where required.

Deliver professional consultations focused on business growth opportunities.

Handle objections confidently and professionally.

Negotiate and secure high-value sales.

Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline management.

Consistently achieve and exceed sales targets.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will be ambitious, commercially minded, and confident speaking with business owners.

A proven track record in sales or business development.

Experience engaging with senior decision-makers.

Strong commercial awareness and business acumen.

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

A consultative approach to selling.

The ability to understand business challenges and identify solutions.

Strong negotiation and closing skills.

High levels of self-motivation, resilience, and professionalism.

A genuine interest in entrepreneurship and business growth.

We welcome applications from individuals with experience in:

B2 B Sales

Business Development

Recruitment

Account Management

Commercial Partnerships

Consultancy

Financial Services

Coaching or Training Sales

SaaS or Technology Sales

Professional Services

Experience selling high-value products or services is advantageous but not essential for the right individual.

Why Join Trade Mastermind?

40,000 basic salary.

Uncapped commission structure with six-figure earning potential.

Warm, qualified leads provided.

Industry-leading sales training and support.

Opportunity to work alongside successful entrepreneurs and business leaders.

Clear opportunities for progression and career development.

Dynamic, ambitious, and high-performing environment.

The chance to genuinely impact the success of UK business owners.

Join Our Team

If you are ambitious, commercially aware, and passionate about helping businesses grow, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a rare opportunity to combine your sales expertise with strategic business conversations while building a highly rewarding and lucrative career.

Apply today and become part of the Trade Mastermind success story.

title: Field New Sales Executive - Service. Lifts, Escalators
description:
Lift Maintenance Service Contracts New Business B2 B Field Sales

Sell a Service You Can Actually Stand Behind

Are you a lift industry salesperson who's at your best opening doors and winning new maintenance contracts, but tired of fighting process, paperwork and a service team that lets you down?

Liftec Express, a leading independent lift and escalator specialist, is growing its sales team. It's looking for a genuine new business hunter to build its lift maintenance portfolio across Milton Keynes, Luton and Cambridge.

No up-to-date CV? No problem. This starts with an informal & confidential chat with Lisa Nicholls, Head of Sales & Marketing.

The Role at a Glance:

New Business Sales Executive
Field-based: Milton Keynes / Luton / Cambridge territory

£50,000 £65,000 Basic DOE + £10,000 £15,000 OTE Uncapped
Car allowance + business mileage reimbursed monthly + company mobile
Full-Time Permanent

Leadership: Lisa Nicholls, Head of Sales & Marketing - ex Otis, Schindler, Lift & Engineering Services

Company: Independent lift and escalator specialist in maintenance, repair, installation and modernisation. Formerly part of Otis, now Private Equity-backed by R Capital

Ambition: £100m turnover by 2035

Focus: New Business Lift Maintenance Contracts Long-Term Client Relationships

Values: Doing the Basics Brilliantly Extreme Ownership Customer at the Centre Honesty & Integrity

Who We Are

At Liftec Express, we keep people moving safely and reliably, while building a company our team is proud of and our customers trust.

Previously part of Otis, Liftec is now an independent business with a big ambition: to become a £100m turnover company by 2035. We'll get there by giving property managers, facilities managers, building owners and main contractors outstanding service from a responsive independent partner.

Why More Salespeople from competitors Are Joining

Less red tape, more selling. You won't spend your week chasing approvals. Our quoting system is slick, decision-makers are accessible, and our MD will look at non-standard terms when there's a good reason. One of our recent hires, who joined from a major OEM, says producing a quote, seeing a customer and getting terms approved is far easier here.

A service you won't have to apologise for. Too often in this industry, salespeople win a contract that the service team then can't deliver. Not here. We do proper maintenance visits of around 45 minutes, not a ten-minute box-tick. We make proactive recommendations, manage shutdowns properly and take every customer issue seriously. You'll never look foolish in front of a client because operations let you down.

A team, not a lone wolf. Big companies often leave their salespeople to fend for themselves. Here, the sales team works together and pulls in the same direction, with real support behind you.

Room to grow. As we scale toward £100m, the sales structure will grow with us, including future leadership roles. Lisa will coach and develop strong performers every step of the way.

Earnings that reward results. You'll get a competitive basic plus commission paid on every lift you bring on contract. The best-structured deals earn the most, and good salespeople can earn very well.

A Word from Lisa

"I joined Liftec because it's an ambitious business with huge potential. It's fast-paced with a great team around you and everyone genuinely wants to help. I felt at home very quickly. We're independent, growing rapidly and there's a real opportunity for good salespeople to come in, make their mark and be part of what we're building."

The Opportunity

This is a pure new business role. There's no inherited account book and no renewals. Your mission is to win new lift maintenance contracts across a patch with thousands of lifts in it.

You'll:
- Build and manage your own prospect pipeline
- Target decision-makers across property management, facilities, building ownership and main contractors
- Take opportunities from first contact through to signed contract
- Conduct site visits and consultative customer meetings
- Prepare proposals, presentations and commercial submissions
- Lead and complete tender submissions, including full commercial review
- Negotiate long-term maintenance agreements
- Keep your CRM pipeline and forecasting accurate
- Work with our operational teams to ensure a smooth handover once business is won

Lift service contracts are typically three years and are well written, so some opportunities mean keeping a prospect warm for the long haul. Others can be won quickly, and there are always one- and two-lift wins to be had. You'll need the drive of a hunter and the patience to build relationships over time.

About You

You'll already be selling lift service and maintenance contracts and know how the industry works. This role needs someone who can hit the ground running, so lift industry experience is essential.

You'll bring:
- A track record of winning new B2 B lift service & maintenance customers
- Strong prospecting and pipeline-building skills
- Consultative, relationship-led selling. SPIN-style approaches work really well here.
- The ability to understand customer pressure points and build trust over long sales cycles
- Strong commercial, negotiation and presentation skills
- Experience with proposals and tenders
- Good CRM and forecasting discipline
- A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel

Service sales here is about long-term relationships and understanding what keeps customers awake at night. It doesn't need the deep engineering expertise of modernisation sales. Our modernisation specialists work alongside you when those opportunities arise.

We're looking for people who are open-minded and inquisitive, take extreme ownership, put the customer at the centre and act with honesty and integrity. If that sounds like you, come and help us build what comes next.

Benefits:
- Competitive base salary
- Car allowance
- Pension from day one through Aviva
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Employee Assistance Programme from day one
- Death in Service cover at three times salary
- Discretionary sickness scheme
- Enhanced maternity and paternity provision, subject to service
- Employee discounts platform
- Employee referral scheme
- Role-dependent incentive scheme

Ready to Open Doors?

Not actively looking, but curious? Good. There's no need for an up-to-date CV. Start with an informal, confidential conversation, and if it feels right, have a chat with Lisa.

Bring the relationships. Build the pipeline. Win the contracts.

Application notice We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

title: Sales Executive
salary_text: £38000 - £42000 per year (+ Car + Fuel + Daily Lunch Subsidy)
description:
GBR Recruitment Ltd are delighted to be working exclusively with a long standing & highly progressive industrial & commercial paints, oils, lubricants, coatings & sealants business.

They are expanding their sales / business development team, recruiting for an experienced Sales Executive who has worked with similar products supplying into a diverse array of end using clients across agriculture, plant machinery, automotive, logistics (hauliers), off highway, marine, engineering, manufacturing & other industry sectors.

As the Sales Executive you will develop & grow business within local dealerships, distributors, commercial businesses, farms, estates, workshops, OEMS & generally anywhere that need to purchase oils, paints, lubricants etc. for their machinery & equipment to either manufacture or service their own.

This key business development role covers Lincolnshire, Cambridgeshire & Northamptonshire & is 80% on the road field based, with one day a week working in the head office.

Duties:
- Field based sales & business development activities
- Maintain, develop & expand product/s spend levels with current clients
- Up sell & cross sell into current clients additional products
- New business development, pitching to & winning new clients
- Mapping out of the territory & pin pointing target clients (new clients)
- Defining & delivering a sales strategy that delivers tangible results
- Market research & market intelligence gathering
- Updating the internal CRM system
- Attending industry events & exhibitions
- Face to face, telephone & email sales activities
- Completing documents & sales reports

Attributes:
- Experienced sales / business development professional with experience or at least some knowledge of industrial & commercial paints, oils, lubricants, coatings & sealant type products or very similar product lines.
- Experienced selling into clients across several of the following sectors; agriculture, plant machinery, automotive, logistics (hauliers), off highway, marine, engineering & manufacturing.
- Strong knowledge of business opportunities in the Lincolnshire, Cambridgeshire & Northamptonshire areas.
- Happy to be field based 80% of the time.
- Able to manage your own diary successfully to achieve real results

This role would suit someone working as a Sales Executive, Business Development Executive, Sales Manager, Business Development Manager, Area Sales Manager, Territory Sales Manager, Sales Representative, Key Account Manager, Regional Sales Manager, Regional Business Development Manager, Field Sales Manager, Field Sales Representative or similar with similar sales & business development responsibilities.

This position would suit those living in Grantham, Stamford, Newark, Corby, Bourne, Peterborough, Oundle, Wisbech, Sleaford, Spalding, Market Deeping, Holbeach, Bourne & Lincoln.

If you are a Sales Executive professional wanting to work for an employer of choice then apply today!

Interviews to take place immediately.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Peterborough

£26,000 - £27,000 - OTE - £35,000

Our client is looking for a motivated, confident, and results-driven Sales Executive to identify potential customers, generate new business opportunities, and support the growth of our sales pipeline.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and research potential customers through online research, databases, LinkedIn, and other lead generation channels.
- Make outbound calls and send targeted emails to prospective clients.
- Generate new business leads and identify opportunities to grow the customer base.
- Qualify prospects by understanding their needs, requirements, and potential interest in our products or services.
- Book appointments, arrange meetings, and schedule demonstrations for the sales team.
- Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions, and follow-up activities within the CRM system.
- Follow up with prospective customers to maximise engagement and conversion opportunities.
- Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to develop effective lead generation strategies.
- Meet and exceed agreed lead generation, call activity, appointment-setting, and conversion targets.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide regular updates on sales pipeline activity.

Skills and Requirements
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Confidence when speaking to prospective customers over the phone and via email.
- Strong research, organisation, and time management skills.
- A proactive, self-motivated, and target-driven approach.
- Ability to handle rejection professionally and maintain a positive attitude.
- Good negotiation, persuasion, and relationship-building skills.
- Basic computer skills and familiarity with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
- Previous experience in lead generation, telesales, telemarketing, or business development is desirable but not essential.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured against agreed targets, including:
- Number of new leads generated.
- Number of outbound calls and emails completed.
- Number of qualified leads passed to the sales team.
- Number of appointments or sales meetings booked.
- Lead-to-appointment and appointment-to-conversion rates.
- Accuracy of CRM records and consistency of follow-ups.

Apply Today

title: Customer Care Office Manager
company: Encon Staffing Associates Ltd - Agency - Permanent
salary_text: £40000 - £50000 per year (Car or Allowance, Health, Pension, B)
description:
Job Title: Customer Care Office Manager
Location: Peterborough
Looking for a career where your ambition meets real opportunity? Join this housebuilder as Customer Care Office Manager and step into a role where your success is celebrated, your growth supported, and your work truly matters.
Why Join them?
We re one of the UK s largest and most established housebuilders FTSE 100 listed, with 29 regional offices and thousands of quality homes built every year.
They don t just build homes we build careers. When you join us as Customer Care Office Manager, you ll benefit from:
- Competitive salary
- Car Allowance
- Commission
- 5 housebuilder - Be part of a company that consistently delivers quality homes and outstanding customer satisfaction
- Life Cover & Contributory Pension
- Healthcare
- Bonus
- Employee Benefits Platform giving you access to high-street discounts, wellbeing support, and more
- Committed to diversity, inclusion, and empowering your development

What is the role?
As a Customer Care Office Manager, you ll lead the Customer Care team to deliver an exceptional customer experience, ensuring high service standards, strong performance, and effective resolution of customer issues.
Working closely with the Customer Care Operations Manager and key stakeholders, you ll help drive operational excellence and continuous improvement across the customer journey.
What will you do as a Customer Care Office Manager?
- Lead, develop and motivate the Customer Care team, setting clear expectations, conducting performance reviews, and providing coaching and training to achieve departmental KPIs and service standards.
- Oversee all customer communications, ensuring enquiries and concerns are managed professionally and efficiently, in line with Customer Care policies, procedures and service level expectations.
- Proactively manage customer escalations and support the effective resolution of formal complaints, ensuring positive customer outcomes wherever possible.
- Champion customer service excellence, driving improvements in customer satisfaction and NHBC survey performance and other industry customer experience standards.
- Work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication, timely resolution of customer issues and successful delivery of remedial works.
- Attend site meetings with customers, operational teams and contractors as required to support service delivery and issue resolution.
- Monitor departmental performance, compliance and governance, ensuring adherence to internal processes, the New Homes Quality Code, Health & Safety requirements and other regulatory obligations.
- Manage departmental systems, performance data and cost controls, including contra-charge processes, using insights to identify trends, drive improvements and support business objectives.

What experience do I need?
- Proven experience in customer service, including experience leading or managing a customer-facing team.
- Strong leadership, coaching and performance management skills, with the ability to motivate and develop others.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships and manage challenging situations effectively.
- Strong customer focus, with experience of handling escalations, resolving issues and delivering excellent customer outcomes.
- Good organisational, problem-solving and prioritisation skills, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with the ability to learn and utilise new systems quickly.
